Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XX OF 1983
BANKS (NATIONALIZATION) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE XX OF 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Banks Nationalization Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th September, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1) 83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Banks (Nationalization)
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 11, Act XIX of 1974

ORDINANCE XX OF 1983
BANKS (NATIONALIZATION) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE XX OF 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Banks Nationalization Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th September, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1) 83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information
2. Amendment of section 11,
Act XIX of 1974.-In the Banks (Nationali zation) Act, 1974 (XIX of 1974),
in section 11, after subsection (7), the following new subsection shall be
inserted shall be deemed always to have been so inserted, namely :-
"(7-A) The
Chairman and a member of the Council and the President and a member of an
Executive Board shall be liable to such disciplinary action and penalties, to
be awarded in such manner and by such Authorities, as may be prescribed."
